commit.message:
feat: Add support for School Form 9 (SF-9) generation (#97)

* feat: Update subheader (#95)

* feat: Automatically detect schema and load matching PDF template (#96)

* feat: Simplify CSV validation to only do basic sanity checks

* feat: Automatically detect schema and load matching PDF template

* feat: Add SF9 excel template and update download dropdown (#98)

* feat: Add SF9 Grade 4-10.xlsx

* feat: Update excel template download dropdown on home page

* fix: SF9 spreadsheet filename

* feat: Adapt PDF generation for SF9 acroform (#100)

* feat: Adapt PDF generation for SF9 acroform

* feat: Remove school information and criteria form sections

* Revert "feat: Remove school information and criteria form sections"

This reverts commit a4ea003b7efc7c4a7cf2460b9262e5bff429308c.

* fix: Remove unused `styleField` function import

* feat: Remove school information and passing criteria sections (#101)

* fix: Align batch export names with SF9 output (#102)

* feat: Style PDF fields; add Bookman Old Style font support (#103)

* feat: Style PDF fields; add Bookman Old Style font support

* fix: Reduce form field font size to 7.8
